newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kohl's party wants election on September 27, 1998.
newsitem.headline: Kohl's party wants election on September 27, 1998.

text.p: Germany's next general election should be held on September 27, 1998, officials from Chancellor Helmut Kohl's Christian Democrats (CDU) and its Bavarian sister party, the Christian Social Union (CSU), said on Tuesday.
This date was proposed at a strategy meeting for CDU/CSU leaders on Monday evening, the officials said. But the date has to be agreed with other parties.

By law, the election must take place between 45 and 47 months after the Bundestag, or lower house, was inaugurated. The last election was held on October 16, 1994 and the next election is due between August and October 1998.
Kohl announced on Monday that the CDU and CSU were planning to talk to the other parties in Bonn about an election date.
